boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Malibu-campus destinations with documented student-facing uses, from study and making to recreation, reflection, and campus events.

cards.title: Payson Library
cards.subtitle: Huntsinger Academic Complex, Malibu campus
cards.notes: Set up a focused work session, reserve a study room when available, or use the library’s research and technology spaces between classes.
cards.short_summary: The Seaver campus library combines study rooms, research resources, making tools, and rotating exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine identifies Payson as its flagship Seaver College library and lists the Genesis Lab, special collections, Bloomberg terminals, an exhibit gallery, and space requests including study rooms.
cards.source_title: Locations, Hours, and Visitor Information | Pepperdine Libraries
cards.access_notes: Payson serves the Pepperdine learning community; public visitors have limited daily access under the library visitor policy.

cards.title: Genesis Lab
cards.subtitle: Inside Payson Library, Malibu campus
cards.notes: Bring a project idea and check the lab’s current availability before planning a session with its 3D-printing and virtual-reality technology.
cards.short_summary: A named Payson Library makerspace for emerging-technology work.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries describes the Genesis Lab in Payson Library as a makerspace with emerging technology, including 3D printers and virtual reality rigs.
cards.source_title: Locations, Hours, and Visitor Information | Pepperdine Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located within Payson Library; confirm current library and space-use requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Boone Special Collections and Archives
cards.subtitle: Inside Payson Library, Malibu campus
cards.notes: Plan research around a specific topic, then contact the library ahead of time if you need to consult archival or other historic materials.
cards.short_summary: An archives destination inside Payson that supports research across disciplines.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries states that Boone Special Collections and Archives in Payson Library holds books, archives, and historic documents supporting research in multiple disciplines.
cards.source_title: Locations, Hours, and Visitor Information | Pepperdine Libraries
cards.access_notes: Researchers requesting access to Boone Special Collections and Archives are directed to email the library to make arrangements.

cards.title: Mullin Town Square
cards.subtitle: Central Seaver College campus, Malibu
cards.notes: Use the central courtyard as a between-class meeting point, a sunny study stop, or a place to check what campus event is taking place.
cards.short_summary: A central campus piazza used for everyday student circulation, studying, and scheduled events.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine’s self-guided tour describes Mullin Town Square as a central campus area where students walk to class, study, and attend events.
cards.source_title: Seaver Admission Self Guided Tour Brochure
cards.access_notes: An outdoor campus space; programming and access conditions can vary with University events.

cards.title: Joslyn Plaza
cards.subtitle: Lower campus near Mullin Town Square, Malibu
cards.notes: Watch for campus programming here and use the plaza as a clear rendezvous point before an event, class, or walk across lower campus.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-campus plaza that hosts sustainability programming and other campus activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine’s Center for Sustainability states that its annual Earth Day celebration takes place in Joslyn Plaza and includes student presentations, activities, and community booths.
cards.source_title: Get Involved with the Center for Sustainability
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza on the Malibu campus; event participation and access depend on the specific program.

cards.title: Stauffer Chapel
cards.subtitle: Seaver College campus, Malibu
cards.notes: Step in for quiet reflection or prayer, and check campus faith and arts calendars for worship services or music performances held here.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel intentionally maintained for individual reflection and communal spiritual formation.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine describes Stauffer Chapel as a space for worship, prayer, rest, reflection, and communal and individual spiritual formation.
cards.access_notes: The University invites campus guests to visit; service and event use may affect availability.

cards.title: Alumni Park
cards.subtitle: Malibu campus
cards.notes: Use the open grounds for a low-key outdoor break, and consult Campus Recreation or event listings before joining recreation or attending a program.
cards.short_summary: A 30-acre campus landscape used for recreational activity, intramurals, sport clubs, and major ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation describes Alumni Park as a 30-acre area used for recreational activities and intramural and sport club events.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space overseen in part by Campus Recreation; organized use may be scheduled.

cards.title: Firestone Fieldhouse
cards.subtitle: Malibu campus
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule for open-gym volleyball, then arrive ready to participate; no advance signup is required for that listed activity.
cards.short_summary: The Waves’ gymnasium also hosts scheduled open-gym volleyball for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Campus Recreation states that open-gym volleyball is offered at Firestone Fieldhouse in fall and spring, with equipment provided and no signup required.
cards.access_notes: Open-gym volleyball is scheduled in fall and spring semesters; confirm the current recreation schedule before going.

cards.title: Howard A. White Center
cards.subtitle: HAWC, Malibu campus
cards.notes: Use this student-services hub as a practical place to connect with Campus Recreation, Student Activities, or the Office of Student Diversity and Inclusion.
cards.short_summary: A named campus center housing several student-facing offices and services.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine’s Malibu campus materials identify the Howard A. White Center as housing Student Activities, Campus Recreation, and the Office of Student Diversity and Inclusion.
cards.access_notes: Check individual office and program information for current availability and entry requirements.

cards.entity_name: Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art
cards.title: Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Cultural Arts Center, Malibu campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition calendar, then spend time with the work or look for the annual senior thesis exhibition by studio art students.
cards.short_summary: The campus art museum connects exhibitions with student learning and student artists’ thesis work.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine states that the Weisman Museum works with studio arts faculty and students to mount the annual senior thesis exhibition and serves as a student learning resource.
cards.source_title: Q and A: Mark Roosa, Pepperdine’s Dean of Libraries and Interim Director of the Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and public hours vary; consult the museum’s current information before visiting.
